subject: Music Production
title: Bollywood and Global Sampling
description: Learn Bollywood and Global Sampling in one minute.

hook.text: Bollywood composers have sampled Western pop, Arab melodies, and African rhythms for decades.

buildup.text: In the 2000s, Western producers began sampling Bollywood soundtracks in hip-hop and dance music.

discovery.text: Timbaland, MIA, and others brought Indian film music samples to global audiences through pop hits.

twist.text: This cross-pollination sparked debates about cultural appropriation versus creative appreciation.

climax.text: Global sampling has created musical fusions that no single culture could have produced alone.

punchline.text: Sampling connects musical traditions across continents.

quiz.question: What debate did cross-cultural sampling spark?
options: Whether digital audio sounds as good as vinyl
Whether live instruments are better than samples
